rule: GOAL: Arrange the bottom colored blocks into the top slots to match the required left-to-right order. CONTROLS: Click a block in the bottom tray to select it, then click an empty slot in the middle grid to place it. RULE: Each successful placement consumes one unit from the step bar at the bottom. TRAP: Thinking you can drag blocks directly; you must perform two distinct clicks, select then place, for every move.

GOAL: Guide the purple square along the diagonal to the ball. CONTROLS: Click a dot to move the square’s center there. RULE: You can only move to dots within a short range; distant clicks fail. TRAP: Thinking you could jump directly to the ball or any visible dot wastes moves.

GOAL: Program five downward moves to drop the plug into the cup. CONTROLS: Click toggle bars or stems to change their state; click the blue circle to execute the sequence. RULE: Toggles set to both blue map to a DOWN move, while white states do nothing. TRAP: Assuming early mixed states like blue-white meant LEFT was incorrect; only the final all-blue configuration triggered the required action.

GOAL: Use the blue platform to catch the falling magenta block and guide it into the yellow cup. CONTROLS: Left and Right arrows slide the blue platform; Spacebar previews the drop path without committing it. RULE: The platform must be positioned directly beneath the block's vertical drop line to catch it. TRAP: Pressing Space is only a preview, not an action; you must manually align the platform before the drop.

GOAL: Align the object’s yellow bar with the wall slot to open the path. CONTROLS: Top blue button pushes the boundary right; bottom blue button pulls it left. RULE: The object sticks to the moving boundary, so shifting the wall moves the object. TRAP: Clicking white or gray areas does nothing; only the blue buttons drive the mechanism.

GOAL: Place all boxes into the designated slots to clear the level. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player; SPACE grabs or releases the box held above the head. RULE: Carrying a box keeps it directly above you, so align your body below the target slot to place it correctly. TRAP: Forgetting that moving down while carrying keeps the box overhead, not pushing it into the floor.

GOAL: Navigate the winding corridor to reach the green tile without hitting dead ends. CONTROLS: Arrow keys moved one cell at a time along the open path. RULE: You could only move through gray gaps; black tiles were solid walls. TRAP: Assuming black spaces were walkable shortcuts wasted time on blocked moves.

GOAL: Slide the green key right to align with the slot. CONTROLS: Click the button below the wall to move the key right. RULE: Pressing a button moves the adjacent block away and the opposite block inward. TRAP: Believing the top block would hit buttons and block progress; it stopped safely.

GOAL: Rotate pink glyphs to match blue targets by cycling through seven states. CONTROLS: Arrows move the cursor; pressing a direction advances the selected glyph to the next state in a fixed seven-step loop. RULE: Each glyph follows the same rotation order, so count steps from your current state to the target and press that many times. TRAP: Assuming each press changes the glyph to a random or unique image, when they actually cycle through a repeating sequence.

GOAL: Extend bars to fully cover cross targets. CONTROLS: Click to grow bars by three units. RULE: Bars win only when completely covering the target center. TRAP: Stopping when bars merely touch the target edges.

GOAL: Match colored pieces to slots using ring indicators. CONTROLS: Click to place pieces; space to confirm. RULE: Flashing rings show mismatches; correct slots stay steady. TRAP: Assuming ring color equals slot color, ignoring that flashing signals errors instead of matches.

GOAL: Arrange the seven symbols into the correct sequence. CONTROLS: Arrows move the cursor; pressing up cycles the current symbol. RULE: Each slot cycles through a fixed seven-symbol loop independent of others. TRAP: Assuming symbols shift together; only the selected slot changes when you press.

GOAL: Arrange seven colored tokens into their correct slots to spell the hidden word. CONTROLS: Click a token to select it, click another slot to swap them, press Space to verify the arrangement. RULE: Each slot has a fixed position in the word; finding one correct token helps deduce the rest. TRAP: Assuming adjacent slots in the visual layout correspond to adjacent letters in the word.

GOAL: Decode a yellow symbol strip into a blue one by splitting the sequence into valid table pairs. CONTROLS: Arrows move the bracket cursor and cycle the blue glyph beneath it. RULE: Only one valid segmentation of the yellow strip exists that produces exactly seven blue symbols. TRAP: Assuming every yellow symbol maps individually ignores the required grouping logic.

GOAL: Place seven colored pieces into specific slots across three boxes to complete the level. CONTROLS: Click pieces from the tray to place them in target slots; press space to submit. RULE: Follow the left-to-right traversal order: red slots, green box, red slots, blue box, red slots. TRAP: Assuming boxes fill independently ignores the sequential path that dictates piece placement order.

GOAL: Match the blue row to the target sequence derived from the yellow row’s segmentation. CONTROLS: Arrows move the cursor and rotate the glyph under it. RULE: The yellow glyphs must be segmented into table keys whose total blue length equals the number of blue slots. TRAP: Assuming a one-to-one glyph mapping ignores that multiple yellow glyphs can combine into a single blue key.

GOAL: Place the socket to dictate the reading order, ensuring the known letter lands on its correct panel position. CONTROLS: Click pieces to move them to target slots; press space to submit your arrangement. RULE: The socket splits the red row; reading goes left red slots, then all green slots, then right red slots. TRAP: Assuming the socket’s column alignment with a green slot directly sets the split; instead, use the known letter’s required position to find the correct split.

GOAL: Arrange red and blue pieces to fit a hidden nine-slot pattern. CONTROLS: Click pieces to place them; press Space to confirm the layout. RULE: The blue block repeats a fixed sequence; adjacent sockets force specific piece orders. TRAP: Assuming gaps exist between sockets; they were actually side-by-side.

GOAL: Match piston heights to target values. CONTROLS: Click side buttons to shift height by two between neighbors. RULE: Height flows only between adjacent pistons; total volume stays constant. TRAP: Thinking extra clicks help. Wasted moves on the middle wall doubled the effort needed.

GOAL: Arrange colored tiles so the visible sequence matches the target pattern. CONTROLS: Click tiles to place them in slots; press space to confirm or advance. RULE: Frames act as portals, linking boxes so traversal continues through the connected frame. TRAP: Assuming frames are just decorative dividers; ignoring their link function breaks the chain.

ESTABLISHED: The arm pushes blocks right until they hit the wall, where they hook. FAILED: Trying to hook or move blocks while they are floating in the middle. GOAL IS NOT: Simply pushing everything to the right edge; alignment matters. CONTROLS: Right extends the arm and pushes blocks. Up and Down move the head, but only drag hooked blocks vertically.

GOAL: Clear the level in three actions by moving past the red hazard. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player one step in the chosen direction. RULE: The red block only moves when the player ends adjacent to it in the same row. TRAP: Thinking the block pushes out of the maze; it is a static wall that kills on contact.

GOAL: Match the target text by adjusting the rotating glyph tiles to form the correct sequence. CONTROLS: Left and Right arrows move the selection bracket between tiles; Up and Down arrows rotate the glyphs within the selected tile. RULE: Rotating a multi-glyph tile moves all its characters in lockstep, so you must find a rotation where every character in the tile matches the target simultaneously. TRAP: Treating each character as an independent switch wastes time; they are bound together, requiring you to solve for the whole tile's position at once.

GOAL: Move a cross shape to a target location on a grid. CONTROLS: Arrow keys shift the cross; Space confirms the move. RULE: Moves that only alter cells near the board’s edge are ignored; changes must occur in the interior. TRAP: Believing any visible change counts, wasting time on moves that only affect the margin.

GOAL: Reduce the board to a single remaining peg. CONTROLS: Click a peg to reveal jump paths, then click a highlighted spot to leap over an adjacent piece. RULE: Each jump removes the jumped peg and moves the jumper to the empty landing space. TRAP: Assuming all jumps are valid; you must have an adjacent piece to jump over, otherwise the move is blocked.

GOAL: Match the outer block colors to the hidden mini-patterns shown in the center of each panel. CONTROLS: Click an outer block to toggle its color between red and blue. RULE: A white mini-tile demands a red outer block; a gray mini-tile demands a blue outer block. TRAP: Assuming the mini-pattern was a preview of the result rather than the strict target state for the outer grid.

GOAL: Move the player into the upper box to finish the level. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player one step at a time. RULE: The gray border is solid, but the black interior is the target zone. TRAP: Believing the white plus was a temporary pickup that vanished; it was a permanent marker.

GOAL: Match the grid colors to the small reference icons. CONTROLS: Clicking a square changes its color to match the icon's active hue. RULE: The icon's center tile reveals which color represents "on" or "active." TRAP: Assuming the center tile is just decoration, causing you to pick the wrong target color.

GOAL: Align the orange X, blue cross, and diamond over their matching dots. CONTROLS: Arrows move the active shape three cells; Space switches to the next shape. RULE: Only the shape under the white marker responds to arrow keys. TRAP: Assuming all shapes move together wastes actions; you must switch focus before moving each piece.

GOAL: Rotate the ring until the yellow block sits directly under the yellow bracket marker. CONTROLS: Click the red arrow to rotate the ring one step in one direction; click the green arrow to rotate it the opposite way. RULE: The puzzle ends only when the yellow block aligns perfectly with the fixed bracket position. TRAP: Believing the arrows move the bracket or that other blocks matter, rather than focusing solely on the yellow block's position.

GOAL: Move the chain's midpoint onto the target ring to complete the level. CONTROLS: Clicking a diamond makes it the head; clicking a location moves the head there, dragging the midpoint along. RULE: The midpoint always sits exactly halfway between the head and tail diamonds. TRAP: Thinking you must move the purple square directly; it is passive and only moves as a result of head and tail positions.

GOAL: Guide a block into a ring-shaped target zone. CONTROLS: Arrows move the active block; click a block to select it. RULE: Clicking a block shifts control, letting you maneuver multiple pieces independently. TRAP: Assuming rings are walls blocks cannot cross; they are floor markers, not barriers.

GOAL: Fit the arrow tip into the head by sliding it left through a narrow channel. CONTROLS: Arrows moved the tip; clicking white keypad cells shrunk its size. RULE: The 4x4 tip could not pass the notch, so it had to be reduced to 2x2 first. TRAP: Believing the tip could slide through the gap at full size wasted time on blocked moves.

GOAL: Paint specific cells orange to satisfy hidden neighbor clues while leaving others red. CONTROLS: Click a cell to toggle its color between red and orange. RULE: Clues on cell edges dictate the color of the adjacent cell, overriding current state. TRAP: Assuming gray cells implied a different background color, wasting time verifying they were already red.

GOAL: Position the line, X, and diamond shapes so their paths cover all eight target dots. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the currently selected shape; Space cycles which shape is active. RULE: Only the active shape moves; toggle selection to align each object independently. TRAP: Assuming touching shapes move as one unit wastes time; they are separate entities despite sharing color.

GOAL: Shrink the tool tip to fit through a narrow vertical passage. CONTROLS: Arrows move the tip; clicking keypad buttons shrinks it. RULE: Matching the panel's dot pattern to the keypad triggers the size reduction. TRAP: Assuming the shrunk tip keeps the same alignment; it shifts, requiring careful repositioning to align with the gap.

GOAL: Align colored blocks by moving them along two horizontal belts and a circular outer ring. CONTROLS: Six buttons adjust the ring and two belts; red arrows shift one way, green arrows reverse that direction. RULE: Ring rotations move blocks through belt entry points, seamlessly transferring items between the circular path and straight tracks. TRAP: Assuming belt and ring movements are independent; failing to account for shared cells where blocks swap lanes causes misalignment.

GOAL: Change two cells to satisfy color constraints and clear the level. CONTROLS: Click a grid cell to cycle its color. RULE: A mini's gray border forces covered cells to take the mini's secondary color, not the center color. TRAP: Assuming gray allows any non-center color; it specifically dictates one unique alternative color per mini.

GOAL: Guide the two blocks to merge at the top row. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move both blocks simultaneously in the chosen direction. RULE: Blocks slide until they hit a wall or another block, not just one step. TRAP: Assuming blocks stop immediately upon contact; they actually occupy adjacent cells unless fully merged.

GOAL: Match the target pattern by pressing switches and moving pieces. CONTROLS: Arrows move your character; clicking switches toggles the shape. RULE: The yellow square fully restores your action budget. TRAP: Assuming the budget is infinite or refills partially; it drains strictly per move and only resets to full at the yellow tile.

GOAL: Move yellow to the left bracket and orange to the right bracket. CONTROLS: Click left ring for yellow; click right ring for orange. RULE: Red clicks move blocks counter-clockwise; green clicks move clockwise. TRAP: Thinking shared cells swap rings instantly; they only pass blocks along their current ring's path.

GOAL: Guide two shapes to cover matching colored dots. CONTROLS: Arrows move, Space switches shapes. RULE: Shapes only dye dots when overlapping the correct color source. TRAP: Assuming any overlap works; wrong colors ignore dots, wasting moves.

GOAL: Move the yellow and orange tokens to their target spots by sliding the grid rows and columns. CONTROLS: Click arrow buttons to shift the top, bottom, left, or right tracks in the indicated direction. RULE: Each track is a continuous loop; shifting one moves all tokens on that track, including shared corner cells. TRAP: Treating the loops as independent rows and columns rather than single continuous cycles causes wasted moves.

ESTABLISHED: The red obstacle is static across multiple steps; moving adjacent to it does not trigger interaction. FAILED: Pressing SPACE near the red block caused a respawn at the start without affecting the obstacle. Idle oscillation steps did not cause the red block to retract or move. GOAL IS NOT: The red block is not a temporary timer-based barrier that vanishes with time or standard player proximity. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player. SPACE triggers a level restart or respawn.

GOAL: Move the white bead to the target gray slot using only ten clicks. CONTROLS: Click a gray cell to slide the bead there if the path is clear. RULE: Straight-line paths cannot cross blue blobs, so you must route around obstacles. TRAP: Assuming you can jump over blue areas wastes moves; always check for blocked lines first.

GOAL: Move both squares to the center without stepping on red checkered tiles. CONTROLS: Arrow keys slide both squares simultaneously in that direction. RULE: Red tiles are instant death, not walls; you must avoid them completely. TRAP: Assuming hazards block movement like walls; they actually kill you if touched.

GOAL: Move both yellow blocks onto the two yellow brackets at the top corners. CONTROLS: Red arrows spin the top row left and the big loop clockwise; green arrows reverse those motions. RULE: The top row and the big loop share five cells, moving them in the same direction when both red arrows are pressed. TRAP: Assuming the top row spins independently; ignoring the shared cells breaks the alignment needed for the final placement.

GOAL: Align plug tips with socket contacts. CONTROLS: Arrows shift piece by fixed steps; Space rotates. RULE: Each move translates exactly three grid cells. TRAP: Assuming rotation repositions the piece; it pivots in place, so position must be fixed before rotating.
GOAL: Slide the bead to the target diamond. CONTROLS: Click to move the bead one step. RULE: The bead stops only on an empty diamond. TRAP: Thinking you must click every cell along the path.

GOAL: Move the black shape to perfectly overlap its mirrored reflection across the central axis. CONTROLS: Arrow keys shift the piece three cells in that direction, while the mirror simultaneously moves the target shape. RULE: The piece’s vertical stem must face the mirror line to match the reflected yellow shape’s orientation. TRAP: Assuming a one-cell step wastes actions; always calculate moves in multiples of three to avoid overshooting the target.

ESTABLISHED: Blue object swaps solid/dither ends between top and bottom slots. Green stands on blue solid at bottom. Gray platform sits above blue slot. Red bar extends right from gray platform. FAILED: Clicking blue socket once only toggles states. No progress clearing level. GOAL IS NOT: Simply toggling blue to access gray platform without crossing red bar. CONTROLS: Click blue socket to swap solid/dither ends. Arrow keys move green. Walkable surfaces support movement; dithered surfaces do not.

GOAL: Navigate the green piece to the yellow token by manipulating colored platforms. CONTROLS: Arrows moved the piece; clicks rotated red bars or swapped blue blocks. RULE: Rotate the red bar to vertical and swap blue blocks to solid to create a continuous path upward. TRAP: Moving the green piece before rotating the red bar leaves it stranded on the horizontal section.

GOAL: Align the reflected shape with the target zone by positioning the mirror and shifting the piece. CONTROLS: Arrows move the active object; Space switches selection between the mirror and the piece. RULE: The reflection mirrors the piece’s position across the mirror; moving the mirror shifts the reflection horizontally. TRAP: Assuming the piece moves when the mirror is selected; you must switch selection before vertical movement.

GOAL: Guide three colored beads to matching rings by calculating their final resting spots. CONTROLS: Click empty grid cells to place invisible guide points that pull beads toward targets. RULE: Beads stop when they align with a ring's center, ignoring decoy rings with mismatched colors. TRAP: Assuming beads stop at the first gray square; they actually pass through until reaching the calculated midpoint.

GOAL: Move the blue X to cover blue dots and dye the green diamond red to cover red dots. CONTROLS: Arrows move shapes; Space switches the active shape. RULE: Shapes change color only when their outline overlaps a colored square. TRAP: Assuming the diamond needed to start red; it must travel through the red zone to change color.
GOAL: Move your block into the head's center. CONTROLS: Arrows slide the block one step. RULE: Gray paths show safe travel routes. TRAP: The head is five wide, not six.

ESTABLISHED: The canvas requires a white top half and purple bottom half. Down-pours paint the top rows; up-pours paint the bottom. FAILED: Navigating to the pouring position via rotation is blocked or inefficient. Clicking the canvas does nothing. GOAL IS NOT: A single pour that colors the entire canvas correctly in one step. CONTROLS: Arrow keys rotate the bucket's opening. Space pours. Mouse clicks on the bucket are untested.

GOAL: Slide two pieces so their reflections land on yellow targets. CONTROLS: SPACE cycles selection; arrows move the chosen piece. RULE: Mirrors flip vertical position across the center line. TRAP: Thinking yellow dots mean completion; they indicate selection, not solved status.

GOAL: Group the scattered yellow blocks into their matching clusters. CONTROLS: Click arrows to rotate arms, click blocks to swap them. RULE: Rotating an arm cycles its blocks, letting you align colors without swapping every piece. TRAP: Assuming swaps were faster than rotations; spinning the correct arm solved multiple mismatches at once.

GOAL: Reach the yellow token by rotating the red bar to create a bridge. CONTROLS: Arrows moved the green square; clicks rotated bars. RULE: Adjacent bars allow walking if their rows overlap. TRAP: Assuming the red bar rotates downward; it actually rotated upward, requiring an immediate rightward move to cross onto it.

ESTABLISHED: The screen shifts downward by twenty-four pixels between actions. FAILED: Moving one or twelve pixels down leaves the layout unchanged. GOAL IS NOT: A simple rigid translation of the entire scene. CONTROLS: The down command moves the view; other inputs do nothing.

GOAL: Move two yellow tokens into the matching bracket slots. CONTROLS: Green buttons rotated loops one way; red buttons rotated them the opposite way. RULE: Shared corner cells linked independent loops, letting one move shift tokens across both paths. TRAP: Assuming loops were separate wasted time; they were connected at specific intersection points.

GOAL: Reach the exit while eliminating all red enemies. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move one step; entering a red’s cell destroys it. RULE: Red enemies lunge one step forward if you end a turn directly in front of them. TRAP: Assuming reds stay static; ignoring their facing direction leads to instant death by lunging attacks.

GOAL: Retrieve a key trapped in a piston chamber. CONTROLS: Click pistons to shift fluid volume between connected columns. RULE: Valves open only when fluid levels on both sides align exactly one unit above the window floor. TRAP: Assuming one side reaching the target height triggers the valve; both sides must match precisely.

GOAL: Slide the long bar onto the mirror to complete the reflection. CONTROLS: Arrows moved the active piece; Space cycled selection between pieces. RULE: Only the selected piece moves, and its dots change color to show status. TRAP: Assuming dots stay white when selected; they turn yellow when overlapping targets, hiding selection state.

GOAL: Route to the multi-object to shift the legend color from orange to blue before reaching the final plus symbol. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player; pressing the plus symbol cycles the shape; stepping on the multi changes the legend color. RULE: The final box only accepts the blue S2 shape, requiring the color shift to happen before the shape is set. TRAP: Assuming the multi object is permanent; it is consumed upon first use, so missing it forces a restart.

GOAL: Reach the exit by timing your moves to dodge a cycling orange threat and destroy a static red guard. CONTROLS: Arrow keys moved your character one step in the chosen direction. RULE: The orange occupied specific cells at predictable time intervals, requiring you to wait or move precisely to avoid collision. TRAP: Assuming you could swap places with the orange without consequence caused fatal collisions when they arrived at your new position.

GOAL: Clear the level by guiding a shape to absorb targets in three stages. CONTROLS: Click endpoints to move handles; drag to shift the bead. RULE: The bead only absorbs targets when its exact cells align with the target shape. TRAP: Assuming any near-alignment works; precise cell matching is required for absorption.

GOAL: Align floating keys with their matching locks to open the exit. CONTROLS: Click valves to swap fluid levels between adjacent tanks, raising or lowering keys. RULE: Keys float on the surface, so matching tank heights ensures correct vertical alignment. TRAP: Assuming keys stay fixed; they actually move with the fluid, requiring careful height calibration.

GOAL: Guide the growing block into the final gate using limited movement actions. CONTROLS: Arrows move the block; pressing a direction while facing it triggers growth away from the facing side. RULE: Growth always expands opposite to the direction you are currently facing. TRAP: Believing growth expands toward your facing direction wastes moves and misaligns the block.

GOAL: Place two images to cover all yellow dots exactly. CONTROLS: Arrows moved the selected object; Space switched between the piece and mirrors. RULE: The piece’s images are fixed relative to it, so moving one moves both. TRAP: Believing images could slide independently wasted time; they move as a single rigid unit.

GOAL: Move the yellow key from the top-left to the top-right slot by adjusting fluid levels. CONTROLS: Click the left tube to lower top-left fluid and raise bottom fluid; click the right tube to lower top-right fluid and raise bottom fluid. RULE: Valves only unlock when the fluid surface aligns perfectly with the key's bar, allowing it to pass. TRAP: Assuming the key moves immediately after clicking; it waits until the fluid level drops enough to expose the bar to the valve.

GOAL: Guide the green block to the core, then activate the purple plug to power the wire. CONTROLS: Arrows move the block; clicks activate sockets on the side panel. RULE: Cells with three or more colored quadrants are solid and walkable; two is not. TRAP: Assuming the purple plug was fixed scenery instead of a pickup item you must step on to unlock the socket.

ESTABLISHED: The grid is 9 cells wide with a center column. The two squares are currently vertically stacked. FAILED: Vertical alignment of the two squares does not clear the level. GOAL IS NOT: Simply stacking the blocks one above the other. CONTROLS: Pressing a direction moves both squares simultaneously; the left square mirrors the right square’s movement.

GOAL: Create a horizontal pair of squares aligned with the center column. CONTROLS: Arrows move the left square normally; the right square moves in the opposite direction. RULE: You win only when two squares sit side-by-side in the same row, bridging the middle. TRAP: Assuming vertical alignment counts as a match; stacking squares vertically does not clear the level.

ESTABLISHED: The platform sits on band four. Slot three registered as filled in an earlier attempt. FAILED: Single-pour configurations either miss slots or cause spills, which did not clear the level. GOAL IS NOT: A single liquid pour that fills all three slots without any spillage. CONTROLS: Right moves the platform one column; Space releases the liquid.

GOAL: Cycle the object's color to blue, then push it into the box. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player; stepping onto the multi changes the held item's color. RULE: Colors cycle in a fixed order: green to red, red to orange, orange to blue. TRAP: Believing the color change was random; guessing wastes moves, but the sequence is deterministic.

GOAL: Make every mini satisfy its own color rule for all covered cells, including hidden ones. CONTROLS: Clicking a mini flips its color and toggles the cells it marks as different. RULE: Constraints apply to all cells under a mini, not just the visible block. TRAP: Assuming hidden cells are ignored leads to unsolvable states; they must match the rule.

GOAL: Connect all nodes by docking the green and blue pieces to their targets. CONTROLS: Arrows move selected pieces; clicks select them. RULE: Pieces dock when contacts align with tips; sliding apart or re-aligning maintains connection. TRAP: Assuming strict one-action-per-bar-cost; moving before docking caused unnecessary re-alignment steps.

GOAL: Shift colored blocks to form a specific pattern by stretching dimensions and moving components. CONTROLS: Buttons expand or shrink block lengths; others translate positions horizontally or vertically. RULE: Stretching a block pushes attached elements, allowing precise alignment within narrow corridors. TRAP: Wasting actions on redundant state checks; trust initial predictions and verify only at phase ends.

GOAL: Navigate the grid to the exit while evading moving enemies. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player exactly two spaces per press. RULE: Enemies and the player move simultaneously; landing on an enemy’s current or next position causes death. TRAP: Assuming you can stop after one space or that enemies pause; this ignores the mandatory two-space slide and simultaneous timing.

GOAL: Guide the green square to the yellow goal by crossing a moving barrier. CONTROLS: Arrows moved the green square; clicks shifted the barrier and changed floor colors. RULE: The green square could only stand on safe tiles, requiring careful timing with the barrier's position. TRAP: Believing the barrier's color change was independent of its position caused failed attempts and wasted moves.

ESTABLISHED: Two boards exist with columns already vertically aligned. Left and right arrows change the selection ring color. FAILED: Clicking empty tiles on board C. Pressing arrows without selecting a board frame. GOAL IS NOT: Simply aligning the boards vertically, as they are already aligned. CONTROLS: Click to select. Left and right arrows cycle or recolor the selection ring.

ESTABLISHED: Three blue boxes sit in the top bar. Three empty slots remain below them. You stand beside a dark gray box with a blue center. FAILED: Grabbing the adjacent gray box did not attach it to your hands, leaving it stuck on the floor. GOAL IS NOT: Simply placing boxes in any order; the remaining slots are strictly below the filled ones. CONTROLS: SPACE grabs or drops. Arrows move the player and carried box together.

GOAL: Place all boxes into the bar slots. CONTROLS: Arrows move your body to push or drop boxes. RULE: Boxes change color when placed correctly in the frame. TRAP: Assuming all boxes must look identical; focus on position, not color.

GOAL: Force two blocks to collide and merge into a single unit. CONTROLS: Arrows move both blocks simultaneously; clicks select or deselect a block. RULE: When both blocks move in the same direction, they push each other; if they meet, they merge. TRAP: Believing you must move blocks independently; trying to separate them when they are already adjacent wastes time and prevents the merge.

ESTABLISHED: The head's shell is a six-wide box with a four-deep interior opening downward; the green bar drops two cells per valid move, while blocked moves cost nothing. FAILED: Pressing up six times from the corridor below only moves the tip five rows, leaving it one row short of the interior center. GOAL IS NOT: Fully inserting the tip deep into the shell's interior is not required for completion. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the tip; blocked moves are free; clicking interface elements consumes budget.

GOAL: Clear the level in just two moves by merging tokens. CONTROLS: Click cells to move tokens toward each other. RULE: Tokens merge when brought within close proximity. TRAP: Assuming you must click every intermediate step; one large move suffices.

ESTABLISHED: The left panel has two buttons: one runs the program, the other transposes the board. The right panel has only a run button. The left program now includes a fourth row of four white-blue blocks. FAILED: Clicking the gray left button did not reveal new movement from the fourth row. GOAL IS NOT: The fourth row is not a simple directional move like up or down. CONTROLS: The left button executes all program rows. The right button rotates the board layout.

GOAL: Clear the sky's path to cover the right cross. CONTROLS: Blue moves walls left; Pink lifts walls up; Red sinks walls down; Orange grows the sky right. RULE: Walls must be moved out of the sky's horizontal lane before growth begins. TRAP: Growing the sky while walls block the lane wastes moves and stalls progress.

ESTABLISHED: Clicking a block selects it; walking moves the selected block. Pressing direction pushes adjacent blocks away. FAILED: Pushing B2 up with B3 at (16,3) did not clear the level. GOAL IS NOT: Simply moving B2 to rows 6-7. CONTROLS: Click to select. Arrow keys move selected block.

GOAL: Move all numbered blocks into the single ring target. CONTROLS: Arrows move the active block; clicking a block makes it active. RULE: Only the block with the white dot responds to arrow keys. TRAP: Assuming all blocks move simultaneously wastes time; you must switch control manually.

ESTABLISHED: The mirror sweep covers rows 10 to 34 in a stride-6 pattern, hitting only three residue classes per blob. FAILED: Placing blobs to cover all residues with a single height sweep, as gaps remain in the uncovered residue classes. GOAL IS NOT: Simply sweeping heights 10 to 34, since this misses specific row residues required for the target pattern. CONTROLS: Height presses sweep the mirror; movement presses position the three objects to align their coverage residues with target rows.

GOAL: Merge two squares by navigating through colored gates that only open when a square stands on a matching color plate. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move both squares simultaneously; one moves normally, the other mirrors its horizontal movement while matching vertical direction. RULE: Gates remain open only while a square occupies a plate of that color, requiring precise timing to keep paths accessible. TRAP: Assuming gates open instantly when a square steps onto a plate; they rely on pre-move occupancy, so you must plan ahead.

GOAL: Rotate the long bar 180 degrees and move it up and right to connect the two endpoints. CONTROLS: Click to select, Space to rotate, Arrow keys to move. RULE: The bar must touch both endpoints simultaneously without overlapping other pieces. TRAP: Assuming you can move the bar before rotating it; rotation changes the shape's footprint, so rotate first to clear the path.

GOAL: Merge scattered pieces into one shape and guide it to the target ball. CONTROLS: Clicking moves the selected piece toward the cursor within a limited range. RULE: Pieces merge only when their boundaries touch; separate clusters must be joined before delivery. TRAP: Attempting to push pieces across gaps without merging them first wastes moves and fails.

GOAL: Move both cross-shaped blocks onto their matching outlines to complete the puzzle. CONTROLS: Arrows move the green dot; pressing an arrow while adjacent to a block slides it five spaces in that direction. RULE: Blocks slide continuously until they hit a wall or another block, not just one step.
